title: MinimalReadsetToken
description: JSON schema for minimal read-set / disclosure tokens (MIN_READSET_TOKEN and HMAC_READSET_TOKEN) used as alternative-design baselines in E02 comparator studies.

actor_id.description: Actor user identifier authorized to observe and act on the state.

actor_role.description: Role of the actor when the read-set was captured (e.g. owner, clinician).

purpose.description: Governed purpose of use (e.g. self_care, clinical_review).

snapshot_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the disclosed snapshot content.

evidence_commitment.description: Deterministic commitment (SHA-256 or Merkle root) over the disclosed evidence set.

key.description: Domain or semantic key dependency (e.g. domain:semantic_key).

policy_version.description: Policy version governing the admission decision.

consent_version.description: Consent version in effect when the read-set was captured.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which this read-set token is expired.

disclosed_evidence_ids.description: Optional list of disclosed evidence IDs included for provenance transparency.
